dataset.name: UChicago AZA-HiDAC-Mito AML cohort (GSE152431)
dataset.description: Independent high-risk AML treatment cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The phase I study enrolled patients with high-risk acute myeloid leukemia treated with azacitidine priming followed by high-dose cytarabine and mitoxantrone. TRACE Explorer retains one pretreatment RNA profile for each patient explicitly labelled AML or therapy-related AML in the pinned sample workbook. Profiles labelled only as myeloid neoplasm and patients with no pretreatment RNA are excluded.

metadata.source_program: University of Chicago AZA-HiDAC-Mito phase I study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Stranded poly(A)-selected bulk RNA sequencing of bone-marrow or peripheral-blood mononuclear cells, aligned to hg19 with STAR 2.5.3
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival in months for the AZA-HiDAC-Mito cohort
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The public workbook supplies exact individual survival duration and vital status but does not define the clinical time origin. TRACE Explorer preserves the source endpoint without claiming a harmonized diagnosis-, enrollment- or treatment-anchored origin.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned GEO sample-information workbook contains a unique RNA sample name, patient identifier, diagnosis, age, sex, overall-survival duration and vital status. Its 104 RNA records map one-to-one to the 104 count-matrix columns.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only Day-0 AZA-HiDAC-Mito RNA profiles with an explicit AML or therapy-related AML diagnosis are eligible. When both bone-marrow and peripheral-blood profiles exist for a patient, bone marrow is selected first and the source lane is the deterministic secondary tie-breaker. This leaves 23 patients from 26 eligible pretreatment libraries.
metadata.source_metadata_discrepancy_note: The workbook labels patient 19's bone-marrow specimen as recurrent AML and the paired peripheral-blood specimen as de novo therapy-related AML. Both GEO records identify the disease state as AML and agree on patient ID, treatment, age, sex, survival time and vital status. The prespecified tissue-priority rule selects the bone-marrow profile; the conflicting subtype fields are retained in source provenance but are not treated as patient invariants.
metadata.disease_scope_note: Five participants labelled only as myeloid neoplasm are excluded rather than inferred to have AML. Three additional AML patients have Day-5 but no Day-0 RNA and are excluded from this pretreatment release.
metadata.overlap_note: This phase I AZA-HiDAC-Mito cohort is kept separate from the historical HiDAC-Mito comparator released from the same GEO series and from the promoted OHSU and AMLCG cohorts.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Direct source-file redistribution remains disabled under the conservative GEO repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Day-0 bone-marrow or peripheral-blood mononuclear-cell AML specimen collected before AZA-HiDAC-Mito

expression.label: GEO raw counts normalized as log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned GSE152431 count matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 27,945 source gene symbols are unique both exactly and case-insensitively; no implicit aggregation is performed.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 27,945 source gene rows for each selected pretreatment specimen and applies log2(CPM + 1). Values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause according to the source workbook; living patients are censored at the source-provided follow-up duration
